correctness.rationale: The translation x_i↦x_i+h forces W=0 for unbalanced frequencies. For balanced alpha, increments d_j in F2²\{0} and closing-sum exclusion yield the exact formula (-1)^(n-1)[3(-3)^k0−Σ_{g≠0}(-3)^kg]. A four-power cancellation reduces modulo 3 at the least exponent: exactly three terms have exponent r and the fourth has exponent r+1, giving only n=4r+1 and precisely the two prefix-count patterns. Multinomial counting gives E_n=(4r)!(4r+1)/((r!)^4(r+1)); rank=4^(n-1)-E_n. Independent full-cube integer Walsh transform and direct proper-colouring enumeration were rerun for n=3..8, including n=5 extra 60 zeros/rank196. The direct proof—not finite checks—covers every n≥3.
